title: Check on an encoded pair
statement: For any data object $d$ and bit strings $x$, $U$, $t$, and $e$, the check on the encoded pair of $x$ and $U$ holds if and only if $t$ has length at most $d.B$ times the quantity one plus the length of that encoded pair, raised to $d.b$, and the core condition holds for $x$, $U$, $t$, and $e$.
